dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/baseimage-ubuntu:resolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG EMBY_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND="noninteractive"

# add needed nvidia environment variables for https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-docker
ENV NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES="compute,video,utility"
ENV ATTACHED_DEVICES_PERMS="/dev/dri /dev/dvb /dev/vchiq /dev/video1? -type c"

RUN \
  echo "**** add emby deps *****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    libexpat1 && \
  echo "**** install emby ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /app/emby \
    /tmp/emby && \
  if [ -z ${EMBY_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    EMBY_RELEASE=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/MediaBrowser/Emby.Releases/releases \
    | jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.prerelease==true )) | .tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/emby.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/MediaBrowser/Emby.Releases/releases/download/${EMBY_RELEASE}/emby-server-deb_${EMBY_RELEASE}_amd64.deb" && \
  dpkg-deb -xv /tmp/emby.deb /tmp/emby/ && \
  mv -t \
    /app/emby/ \
    /tmp/emby/opt/emby-server/* && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8096 8920
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-emby-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# Create folders
mkdir -p \
    /data

# check Library permissions
PUID=${PUID:-911}
if [ -d /config/config ] && [ ! "$(stat -c %u /config/config)" = "$PUID" ]; then
    echo "Change in ownership detected, please be patient while we chown existing files"
    echo "This could take some time"
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config
fi

units.name: svc-emby
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# env settings
APP_DIR="/app/emby"
export FONTCONFIG_PATH="${APP_DIR}"/etc/fonts
export OCL_ICD_VENDORS="${APP_DIR}"/etc/OpenCL/vendors
export AMDGPU_IDS_PATH="${APP_DIR}"/share/libdrm/amdgpu.ids
export PCI_IDS_PATH="${APP_DIR}"/share/hwdata/pci.ids
if [[ -d "/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu" ]]; then
    export LIBVA_DRIVERS_PATH=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/dri:"${APP_DIR}"/lib/dri:"${APP_DIR}"/extra/lib/dri
fi
export SSL_CERT_FILE="${APP_DIR}"/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export HOME="/config"

exec \
    s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8096" \
        cd /app/emby env LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${APP_DIR}"/lib:"${APP_DIR}"/extra/lib s6-setuidgid abc /app/emby/system/EmbyServer \
        -programdata /config \
        -ffdetect /app/emby/bin/ffdetect \
        -ffmpeg /app/emby/bin/ffmpeg \
        -ffprobe /app/emby/bin/ffprobe \
        -restartexitcode 3

notes.upstream:
﻿
## Changes



### 4.11.0.10

- Fix live TV regressions
- Improve database performance
- Fix play all and shuffle from folder view
- Add options to render PGS, DVDSUB and DVBSUB subtitles directly in the browser without server-side burn-in. Requires Emby Server 4.11.0.10+.



### Cumulative Changes Since Stable Release

- Fix live TV regressions
- Support image processing with svg files
- Fix tv series nfo regression
- Fix play from albums tab
- Add Czech parental ratings
- Trim recording file name to avoid PathTooLongException
- Update to libvips 8.18
- Support creating image collage with libvips
- Fix network section coming up empty in directory picker on Windows
- Support scheduling system wakes for recordings on macOS
- Support scheduling system wakes for recordings on Linux
- Support deleting to recycle bin on Linux
- Fix recording regression
- Fix regression with Included In display not showing collections
- Disable scanning of combined season and episode numbers in file names (e.g. 408), and require a library option to enable it
- Support dynamic series orders from Tvdb
- Add automatic subtitles on skip back feature
- Fix episodes without season numbers not showing in resume
- Fix error for servers running on mono runtime
- Filter duplicate entries in person credits
- Improve search performance
- Query fixes for extras belonging to multi-version movies
- Fix cases of episode intro detection retrying failed files endlessly
- Refresh metadata on playlists when removing items
